name: AgentSlackRun
description: Slack-transport twin of AgentRetrievalRun: loads enabled retrieval_cases, dispatches each to AgentSlackDispatch (FirstClassDarwin via the real Slack path), polls retrieval_results, posts the same summary to C0BQH5S6P1P. Run ids carry the agent-slack- pref

nodeGroups.name: Case selection
nodeGroups.description: Builds the run id and loads enabled retrieval_cases, filtered by category/slug input

nodeGroups.name: Dispatch loop
nodeGroups.description: Fire-and-forget dispatch of each case to AgentSlackDispatch, 3 per batch, 40s pacing

nodeGroups.name: Poll results
nodeGroups.description: Polls retrieval_results every 20s until all cases land or 90 polls pass

nodeGroups.name: Report
nodeGroups.description: Builds the summary table, posts it to C0BQH5S6P1P, and triggers the perf report
